verdict.rationale: Bolt supports git-based versioning (auto-sync commits, branches, create/import repos) and code-view editing that lets users inspect changes, and community reports mention informally 'reverting' to a prior prompt state, but there's no documented dedicated rollback/checkpoint UI or structured review workflow for automations. missing for 10: explicit rollback/checkpoint feature, formal diff/review tooling, and versioning aimed specifically at 'automations' rather than app code.
